name: ShinkaEvolve
description: Sakana AI's evolutionary program-search framework. Arena provides a native whole-run driver, saved-result reader and a task-suite evaluation bridge.
limitations: A local native CLI driver, SQLite result reader and Arena suite evaluator bridge are implemented at this source pin.
The bridge preserves raw score, objective direction and explicit validity; task dependencies and per-task conformance must still be checked.
The native environment and a full model-driven run have not been verified. Pause, resume and end-to-end canonical comparison remain separate integration work.
